stem: What is the main DIFFERENCE between the authors' purposes for including information about agriculture in the articles “Counting like the Maya” and “An Ancient Farming Method”?

options.label: A
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions agriculture only as a supporting detail to transition to the main topic of Mayan math, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” positions agriculture as the main accomplishment of the Inca.

options.label: B
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” mentions agriculture to suggest that it led to other scientific successes for the Maya, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” suggests that the reverse was true for the Inca.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” discusses agriculture to show how Mayan culture remained consistent over time, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” uses agriculture as a way to highlight how Inca culture progressed.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of “Counting like the Maya” discusses agriculture to demonstrate how simple life was for the Maya, while the author of “An Ancient Farming Method” uses the same topic to show how advanced the Inca were.
